on PrepareQuizliTemplated
	
	local tTemplateCategories
	local xIndex, tFinalArrayA
	
	put empty into sortedEmailTemplates 
	repeat for each key xThisKey in eMailSupportSystem["templates"]
		// FIRST WE ARE SORTING INTO CATEGORIES
		
		
		put eMailSupportSystem["templates"][xThisKey] into tTemplateCategories[eMailSupportSystem["templates"][xThisKey]["category"]][item 2 of the extents of tTemplateCategories[eMailSupportSystem["templates"][xThisKey]["category"]] + 1]
		
	end repeat
	
	put tTemplateCategories into sortedEmailTemplates 
	
	// ADD EACH CATEGORY TO FINAL ARRAY
	
	repeat for each key xCategory in sortedEmailTemplates 
		repeat with xNumber = 1 to item 2 of the extents of sortedEmailTemplates[xCategory]
			add 1 to xIndex
			put sortedEmailTemplates[xCategory][xNumber] into tFInalArrayA[xIndex]
		end repeat
	end repeat
	
	put tFinalArrayA into sortedEmailTemplates 
	
end PrepareQuizliTemplated
